text:
Sam: Morning all — quick async check-in. Drop 1-liners: yesterday / blockers / today. Trying to keep it light before the all-hands.

Lina: Yesterday: finished the backend portion of the routing feature, merged feature branch. No blockers. Today: add metrics hooks + smoke tests. Ping @Mike for a quick review on the DB migration script.

Mike: Yesterday: iterated on the batching optimizer, benched locally. Blocker: hitting flaky GPU OOM in one config. Today: trying smaller batch slices and digging into memory traces. @DevOps Bot can you keep the GPU nodes free for a short run at 11:30? :pray:

DevOps Bot: noting request — reserving node pool gpu-pool-2 from 11:25–12:00 UTC. Will post when reservation is live.

Tara: Yesterday: triaged two customer tickets (ID 4382, 4383), one required log-level increase to debug latency spikes. Blocker: waiting on logs retention increase from infra. Today: will draft RCA notes for the ticket.

Jin: Yesterday: small PR for API docs (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/122). No blockers. Today: prep slides for the demo section in the all-hands.

Ava: Yesterday: ran the new eval suite across quantized models; saw a 1.8% drop on few-shot NLI. Blocker: need to confirm if it's eval noise. Today: re-run with fixed seed and add baseline comparisons.

Priya: Yesterday: onboarded two new support interns, did creds setup. Blocker: they need read-only access to dedicated telemetry dashboards. @Noah can you grant that?

Noah: Will grant read-only to telemetry today, Priya. Also taking a look at the infra quota request for Tara.

Sam: Quick asks from me: 1) @Mike — prioritize the GPU OOM trace if possible, we want that optimizer in next deploy. 2) @Lina — add the metrics tag so we can slice by customer tier. 3) If anyone has noteworthy all-hands demos, add a 1-line blurb in #all-hands-demo today.

Mike: Roger. If I don't get a repro by noon I'll open a minimal repro and request help.

Tara: Thanks Noah — pinged infra with the retention ticket ID.

deploy-bot: [deploy] canary routing-service v2.8.1 -> success (instances: 6, avg-latency: 58ms) — https://deploys.redwood-inference/internal/12345

Lina: Noted Sam. Will tag metrics and add a route label for customer_tier. Also added the docs PR link in #docs.

Ava: Re-runs queued, will post results in this thread when complete.

Priya: Interns are up and reading, thanks Noah.

Sam: Thanks team — short and solid. If anything blocks the all-hands demo queue a quick DM to me. Otherwise, see you on the call. :rocket:
